digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate routing and T10 infra criterion
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria should be enabled as blocking with default_posture blocking and block_threshold 0.90 in criteria_routing.json
T10 findings should only warrant severity major for destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret, or unauthenticated internet-reachable service classes
T10 DetGateRule must be added to det_gate_rules.py with regex matching terraform, cloudformation, ansible, kubernetes, and related infra keywords to pre-gate non-infra plans
Blocking behavior for T3 and T10 findings requires priority thresholds above 0.90 to block, below to remain advisory, enforced by Pass-3 existing pipeline
Two pinned test assertions must be updated: full routing table in test_threshold_recalibration.py and approved-blocking-criteria set across test files
